facts.c: From 1 August 2025 the Bangladesh Embassy in Kuwait checks the salary in the work permit against its minimum salaries before attesting a visa or demand letter; employers may pay more
facts.q: will verify these minimum salaries in the 'Work Permit', while attesting Visa/Demand Letter from August 01, 2025

facts.c: The minimum salaries are set in the Embassy Labour Wing's circular No.BDEM/LW/Kuwait/Ad/2025 of 7 July 2025
Visa-20 (domestic) unskilled house boy and general labour: minimum KD 120 a month, consolidated
facts.q: 1. House Boy: 120.000 KD (Consolidated) 2. General Labour: 120.000 KD (Consolidated)

facts.c: Visa-20 (domestic) skilled chef and driver: minimum KD 150 a month, consolidated
Visa-18 government-contract (aqud hukumi) unskilled agricultural worker, cleaner and general labour: minimum KD 90 a month for 8 hours
facts.q: Visa-18: Government Contract (Aqud Hukumi) Unskilled Worker 1. Agricultural Worker: 90.000 (For 8 hours) 2. Cleaner: 90.000 (For 8 hours) 3. General Labour: 90.000 (For 8 hours)

facts.c: Visa-18 government-contract skilled driver: minimum KD 120 for 8 hours
facts.q: Government Contract (Aqud Hukumi) Skilled Worker 1. Driver: 120.000 (For 8 hours)

facts.c: Visa-18 private-contract (aqud ahali) unskilled cleaner, general labour and guard: minimum KD 90 for 8 hours; agricultural worker and 'sponsor' KD 120
facts.q: 2. Agricultural Worker: 120.000 (For 8 hours) 3. Cleaner: 90.000 (For 8 hours) 4. General Labour: 90.000 (For 8 hours) 5. Guarder: 90.000 (For 8 hours) 6. Sponsor: 120.000 (For 8 hours)

facts.c: Visa-18 private-contract skilled service jobs (AC and auto mechanic, assistant, barber, driver, installer, presser, reporter, vendor, waiter): minimum KD 150 for 8 hours; chef KD 250

Visa-18 private-contract skilled construction and manufacturing jobs (mason, electrician, plumber, painter, steel fixer, shuttering carpenter, welder, machine operator, tailor and others): minimum KD 150 for 8 hours
The circular is signed by Mohammad Abul Hossain, Minister (Labour) at the Embassy
